sources.rule: TEST_PLAN: 'sensibilidade: para cada atributo, time com +15 nele vs clone → diferença estatisticamente significativa na métrica associada (headless e QuickSim)'; GAME_DESIGN §26: '5 pontos quase imperceptíveis em um lance; 15+ óbvios' — so the metric is the action the attribute drives, repeated in the played-match engine (full headless matches where the attribute shows in every match: speed, agility, stamina, positioning). QuickSim keeps its own sensitivity test (quicksim.json). minZ = 3 as QuickSim. Trial counts are sized for z well above 3 (A9c, X-81)
